Diwali to Bhai Dooj festival window

conclusions.text: 8 of 19 events separate from zero at the 80% level. Above baseline: Vijayadashami (Dussehra) (+7.9%), Wedding season (Lagan) muhurat cluster (+6.1%), Pitru Paksha (Shraddh) (+3.9%), Chhath Puja (+3.8%), Eid-ul-Fitr (Ramzan Id) (+3.8%). Below baseline: Diwali to Bhai Dooj festival window (−4.7%), Karwa Chauth (−6.2%), Ayodhya Deepotsav (−7.2%).
Wedding season (Lagan) muhurat cluster is the only grade-A effect: +6.1% (80% interval +3.4% to +8.8%, 12 occurrences, 163 quoted days).
Pooled festival windows sit at +0.6% (95% interval −4.2% to +5.6%), too imprecise to confirm or reject the direction the calendar expects.
The path runs from ₹87.9 on 2026-10-29 to ₹98.1 on 2027-12-31, with the seasonal shape peaking at ₹102.2 around 2027-02-10 and bottoming at ₹86.9 around 2027-08-14.

The 95% interval at the end of the horizon is ₹60.5 to ₹159.1 — a band about 101% as wide as the central value. That width is the honest summary of what this history supports; the level is one draw from it, the shape is the part worth trusting.
The selected model (anchor_events) scores 13.0% sMAPE overall, 11.7% at 8–28 days and 14.0% at 29–90 days. It is the best of the candidates tested.
9 of 19 events last two days or less, so each estimate rests on that many observations; the price series itself has no gaps. Event conclusions are associations in a thin sample, not causal effects.
